author: claude
expected: Processing completes and the DSM is available as a map; no 'Processing failed'. General DSM: Z11_Zurich_47.4N_1m_UTM32632.tif (synthetic, zero rotation), chosen by the user.

preconditions.text: fixture present; sha256 recorded; its geotransform rotation/shear terms read and recorded before upload
CT account logged in on every target
test-data site a0000001 exists in the CT org on staging

requirement.text: Also import a general DSM file you have, just to check so we did not break it

steps.text: Deliver the fixture to the target: tablets via adb -s <serial> push into a test folder under Download; W044 via scp to webpc044
Open the authorized test site 'QA engine' (site a0000001, staging)
Maps page import flow (as tests/2026-10-09-terrain-resolution/tools/maps_import.py): pick the file, name it QA_<deviceTag>_CL80003_GENERAL, choose the site, Next (cloud write: one new dataset)
Wait for the server-side DSM processing: poll the dataset's status in the app and with a read-only API GET, up to a time limit set from source
Read the final status in the app (status label, any error text) and from the API; screenshot
Leave the app where it started (always)

steps_note: General DSM chosen by the user on 2026-10-22: the synthetic Zurich 1 m UTM file from the 10-09 terrain test.
title: General DSM import still works (CL-80003 regression)
